name: Your Sky: Hare Nochi Koi
overview: Hinata is a kind-hearted, pure, and positive young man, while Sora is a popular, tsundere senior at the university who is feared as the "Tyrant Prince." They're supposed to be a fake couple...but is this real love?! The destinies of these two, who should never have crossed paths, begin to move dramatically after a certain "lie" they tell on the spur of the moment.
